messages:
elaine: deploybot auto-paused the orbit-edge rollout (v3.0.2) — canary error rate ~12% (503) over 5m :rotating_light:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold applied: orbit-edge@3.0.2. Trigger: canary errors > 10% for 5m. Remaining phases paused.

matt: copying traces. any quick mitigations?

sre-bot: pulling canary logs and node dmesg. initial correlation: kvcache eviction spike after kernel param change. uploading to INC-2026-1456.

elaine: don't roll forward. plan: pin warm pools to 3.0.1, abort pending canaries, cordon affected node-pool, schedule backfill in low-traffic window.

releases-bot: suggested backfill window: 2026-03-23 03:00-05:00 UTC. Owners: matt (SRE), elaine (releases), deploybot (ops).

matt: running pin + pause now:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/orbit-edge orbit=registry/redwood/orbit:3.0.1 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/orbit-edge
```

matt: pinned and paused. aborted canary jobs.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Manual pin to 3.0.1 recorded by matt. Rollout paused.

sre-bot: cordon + kernel revert scheduled; will post when nodes back to healthy and after 1h soak.

elaine: updated release notes: v3.0.2 paused (kvcache regression). linked INC-2026-1456. blocking auto-promote until manual clear.

matt: after soak we'll run regression in a sandbox and decide: re-canary v3.0.2 or ship 3.0.3 patched.

elaine: sending stakeholder update. leaving hold in place until explicit clear.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold: manual clear required by release owner.

matt: closing thread, will reopen when requeue planned.
